summary: After losing one kind of approval, an applicant asks the same commission to consider a different question about the same drawings.
realLife: The commission denied Penn Central a certificate for work with no exterior effect. The applicants then sought a finding that the proposed changes were appropriate to the landmark.
inGame: needs: a permit case record with applicant, certificate, design. A returning attendee can ask why the same drawing is on another agenda.

turns.what: The owner returns under the second certificate with one of the drawings withdrawn.
turns.pulledBy: The architect and owner have settled on a single design.
turns.writesBack: The hearing notice identifies the surviving proposal.
